generatedProse.practice-connection:
Creativity is quietly central to academic work in every subject. Framing a question no one has quite asked, finding an unexpected link between two sources, and seeing a problem from an angle others have missed are all creative acts, and all can be learned. Treat what follows as being about your own essays, projects and problems, not about study in the abstract.

The same habit carries into professional life. Wherever work asks for a fresh idea or a new way through a problem, the people who manage it are the ones who have practised generating options before settling on one. The skill you build here travels well beyond your degree.
